This file goes through all the processing and analysis of the Spring 2026 HQ RX data for 2026 Annual Report

#Step 1: tidy/format data and save to 2026 Annual Report data folder

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(readr)

# Fuels Report
fuels_report <- read.csv("RX25/Report_SurfaceFuels_E.csv", skip = 2)
fuels_report <- fuels_report %>% mutate(Plot = case_when(Macroplot == "BME_RAP013" ~ "RAP_13",
                                                         Macroplot == "BME_RAP014" ~ "RAP_14",
                                                         Macroplot == "BME_RAP015" ~ "RAP_15",
                                                         Macroplot == "BME_RAP016" ~ "RAP_16",
                                                         Macroplot == "FPIPS1T02:08" ~ "PIPS_08",
                                                         Macroplot == "FPIPS1T02:16" ~ "PIPS_16")) %>%
  mutate(Status = case_when(MonStatusOrd == 6 ~ 1, MonStatusOrd == 1 ~ 3, MonStatusOrd == 0 ~ 2))
fuels_report <- fuels_report %>% select(-c(1:2, 10:20, 22:25, 27:35, 37:41, 43:46)) %>% select(Plot, Status, MonStatus, everything())
fuels_report <- fuels_report %>% select(-c(10:13))
fuels_report <- fuels_report %>% rename(ThoHr_Snd = X.3_Snd,ThoHr_Rot = X.3_Rot)

write.csv(fuels_report, "2026 Annual Report Data/RX/fuels_report.csv")

# tree report
tree_report <- read.csv("RX25/Report_Trees_E.csv", skip = 2)
tree_report <- tree_report %>% mutate(Plot = case_when(Macroplot == "BME_RAP013" ~ "RAP_13",
                                                         Macroplot == "BME_RAP014" ~ "RAP_14",
                                                         Macroplot == "BME_RAP015" ~ "RAP_15",
                                                         Macroplot == "BME_RAP016" ~ "RAP_16",
                                                         Macroplot == "FPIPS1T02:08" ~ "PIPS_08",
                                                         Macroplot == "FPIPS1T02:16" ~ "PIPS_16")) %>%
  mutate(Status = case_when(MonStatusOrd == 6 ~ 1, MonStatusOrd == 1 ~ 3, MonStatusOrd == 0 ~ 2))

tree_report <- tree_report %>% select(-c(1:2, 5:8, 13, 17:21)) %>% select(Plot, Status, MonStatus, everything())

write.csv(tree_report, "2026 Annual Report Data/RX/tree_report.csv")

# Burn Severity Report
BS_report <- read.csv("RX25/Report_PostBurnSeverity.csv")
BS_report <- BS_report %>% mutate(Plot = case_when(Macroplot == "BME_RAP013" ~ "RAP_13",
                                                         Macroplot == "BME_RAP014" ~ "RAP_14",
                                                         Macroplot == "BME_RAP015" ~ "RAP_15",
                                                         Macroplot == "BME_RAP016" ~ "RAP_16",
                                                         Macroplot == "FPIPS1T02:08" ~ "PIPS_08",
                                                         Macroplot == "FPIPS1T02:16" ~ "PIPS_16"))
BS_report <- BS_report %>% select(Plot, MonStatus, everything())
write.csv(BS_report, "2026 Annual Report Data/RX/BS_report.csv")

# Data Functions for loading raw FFI output data
# Header loading function
load_headers <- function(directory_path, pattern) {
  list_files <- list.files(path = directory_path, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  data_list <- lapply(list_files, function(file) {
    file_data <- read.csv(file) %>% select(1:10) %>% filter(Visited == "True")
    file_data <- file_data %>% mutate(Comment = "")
  })
  return(do.call(rbind, data_list))
}

load_data <- function(directory_path, pattern) {
  list_files <- list.files(path = directory_path, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  data_list <- lapply(list_files, function(file) {
    if (file.info(file)$size == 0) return(NULL)
    file_data <- tryCatch({
      read.csv(file, skip = 3) %>% mutate(Comment = "")
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("Error reading file: ", file, " - skipping this file.")
      return(NULL)
    })
    return(file_data)
  })
  do.call(rbind, data_list[!sapply(data_list, is.null)])
}
  
directory_path <- "RX25/"  
  
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ 
# Trees
trees_df <- load_data(directory_path, "_Trees - Individuals \\(metric\\)\\.csv$")
list <- list.files(path = directory_path, pattern = "_Trees - Individuals \\(metric\\)\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE) 
trees_headers <- lapply(list, function(file) read.csv(file, nrows = 1))
trees_headers <- do.call(rbind, trees_headers)  
trees_df <- left_join(x = trees_df, y = trees_headers, by = c("MacroPlot.Name", "Sample.Event.Date"))

trees_df <- trees_df %>% select(-c(1, 4, 7, 13, 15:17, 20:22, 26, 27, 31:40))
trees_df <- trees_df %>% mutate(Plot = case_when(MacroPlot.Name == "BME_RAP013" ~ "RAP_13",
                                                 MacroPlot.Name == "BME_RAP014" ~ "RAP_14",
                                                 MacroPlot.Name == "BME_RAP015" ~ "RAP_15",
                                                 MacroPlot.Name == "BME_RAP016" ~ "RAP_16",
                                                 MacroPlot.Name == "FPIPS1T02:08" ~ "PIPS_08",
                                                 MacroPlot.Name == "FPIPS1T02:16" ~ "PIPS_16"))
trees_df <- trees_df %>% mutate(MonStatus = case_when(str_detect(Sample.Event.Date, "2024") ~ 1,
                                                      str_detect(Sample.Event.Date, "2025/04") ~ 2,
                                                      TRUE ~ 3))
trees_df <- trees_df %>% select(-1) %>% select(Plot, MonStatus, Sample.Event.Date, everything())

write.csv(trees_df, "2026 Annual Report Data/RX/trees_df.csv")
```
